, Reason for Mistake: Misidentified the landmark on the August 2021 Vogue cover as the White House. The cover shows Jill Biden at the White House with the Washington Monument visible behind trees; the correct monument is the Washington Monument (555 ft ≈ 185 yards), not the White House (70 ft ≈ 23 yards). This wrong identification led to the incorrect final answer.
